local function phase1()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("West course phase 1:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local frame=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frame=frame+1
 local hp=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 local mp=Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self) and hp>0,'Player died during ordinary recovery')
 if frame==5 then print('Full recovery ready') end
 if mp>=19 then print('Recovery magicka ready') end
 if hp>=79.99 then print('Recovery health full') end
 if mp>=79.99 then print('Recovery magicka full') end
 if frame%30==0 then print('Recovery health='..hp..' magicka='..mp) end
end}}}}

end
local function phase2()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("West course phase 2:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local function aim(p)
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local f=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(f.z,math.sqrt(f.x*f.x+f.y*f.y))-math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch),math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04
end
local points={{util.vector3(5493.75244140625,4482.63916015625,-414.0),util.vector3(5456.83642578125,4585.86279296875,-414.0),util.vector3(5342.26416015625,4582.6962890625,-430.0),util.vector3(5219.10400390625,4504.06787109375,-448.0),util.vector3(5143.69140625,4366.80712890625,-448.0),util.vector3(5161.30322265625,4265.75341796875,-448.0),util.vector3(5244.89208984375,4209.96044921875,-448.0),util.vector3(5382.38623046875,4136.4697265625,-456.0),util.vector3(5544.298828125,4124.85107421875,-452.0),util.vector3(5667.72216796875,4119.32568359375,-452.0),util.vector3(5751.5751953125,4259.359375,-448.0),util.vector3(5832.62939453125,4469.82177734375,-438.0),util.vector3(6003.568359375,4652.728515625,-484.0),util.vector3(6012.8369140625,4862.07275390625,-462.0),util.vector3(6015.5908203125,5066.080078125,-340.0),util.vector3(6032.6630859375,5321.06982421875,-220.0),util.vector3(5997.67578125,5664.48388671875,-154.0),util.vector3(5959.7353515625,5938.85302734375,-156.0),util.vector3(5868.14111328125,6169.01904296875,-162.0),util.vector3(5869.40869140625,6309.90380859375,-162.0),util.vector3(5610.2890625,6276.55615234375,-164.0),util.vector3(5383.66552734375,6273.802734375,-80.0),util.vector3(5191.94091796875,6266.150390625,14.0),util.vector3(4866.353515625,6256.06640625,30.0),util.vector3(4637.029296875,6243.39111328125,28.0),util.vector3(4452.5771484375,6138.79443359375,38.0)}}
local step=1
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Substructure camera settled') end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died on joined corridor')
 if frame==5 then
  local armor=0 local axe=false
  for _,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c1) or item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c3) then armor=armor+1 end
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x90613) then axe=true end
  end
  assert(armor==2 and axe,'Joined chest gear missing') print('Joined corridor ready')
 end
 if step<=#points then
  local p=points[step]
  local d=p-self.position
  if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<25 then print('Joined corridor waypoint '..step..' reached '..tostring(self.position)) step=step+1
  else
   local x,y,f=aim(util.vector3(p.x,p.y,self.position.z+100))
   print(string.format('Joined corridor waypoint %d aim x=%d y=%d',step,x,y))
   if f then print('Joined corridor waypoint '..step..' facing') end
  end
 end
 if frame%15==0 then
  print('Joined corridor Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
  for _,id in ipairs({{0x3b52e}}) do
   local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
   if obj and obj:isValid() then print('Joined room actor '..id..' pos='..tostring(obj.position)..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(obj))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(obj).current) end
  end
 end
end}}}}

end
local function phase3()
local output=print
local function print(...) output("West course phase 3:",...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local function aim(p)
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local f=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(f.z,math.sqrt(f.x*f.x+f.y*f.y))-math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch),math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Substructure camera settled') end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at actual Subterrane door')
 if frame==5 then print('Actual Subterrane door ready') end
 if self.cell and self.cell.id==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x22288) then print('Actual Imperial Subterrane entered') return end
 local door=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x3816c))
 assert(door and door:isValid(),'Original Subterrane door missing')
 local x,y,f=aim(door:getBoundingBox().center)
 print(string.format('Actual Subterrane door aim x=%d y=%d',x,y))
 if f then print('Actual Subterrane door focused') end
end}}}}

end
local input=require('openmw.input')
local phases={{phase1,phase2,phase3}}
local n=1
local active=phases[n]()
local held=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F8)
 if down and not held then n=n+1 assert(phases[n],'Unexpected west observation phase') active=phases[n]() print('West observation phase '..n..' ready') end
 held=down
 active.engineHandlers.onFrame(dt)
end}}}}
